Hi all — quick technical notes after an initial review of the sku-matrix.xlsx Sarah attached:

- Common root cause: portal/display latency vs entitlement service propagation. If manifest planIds are unique and you use the standard plan-level entitlement mapping, the portal will reflect what the entitlement service returns. There's an async propagation window (usually seconds, but can be minutes) if the customer provisioning triggers an external webhook or if there are conditional offers.

- Things to validate in manifest.json (please attach):
  * planId uniqueness across offers (no duplicate planId strings)
  * ordering of plans in the offer package (Azure sometimes shows the first matching plan in the UI during race conditions)
  * make sure you include explicit "entitlementPriorities" in the plan metadata if you rely on precedence (we've seen publish pipelines ignore implied order)

- Repro checklist I ran in a sandbox: create account -> purchase paid SKU via marketplace -> check entitlement API (/entitlements/v1) immediately and at +1m, +5m. If API shows paid entitlement but portal still shows trial, that's a UI cache. If API shows trial and later switches, that's entitlement propagation.

If you can drop the manifest.json here (rename to manifest.json to avoid upload blockers), I'll run a quick lint pass and flag anything suspicious.
